Figure 1: Overall architecture of RUFNet. Support and query images are encoded by a shared backbone, the support mask is refined by AGMR, and Hybrid Mamba blocks model support-query interaction. UAPF then fuses the metaprediction with the refined prior to produce the final segmentation.
Table 3: Quantitative comparison of segmentation performance between RUFNet and other methods
Figure 4: Qualitative comparison between PANet and RUFNet under the few-shot setting. RUFNet produces masks that more closely match the ground-truth tumor location and extent.

Figure 2: Architecture of the Attention-Guided Mask Refinement (AGMR) module. Cross-attention aligns query and support features, and the support-mask embedding is fused with the aligned representation to generate a soft refined mask M̂S .

Figure 5: Qualitative visualisation of RUFNet under support-set variation. Panels (a) and (b) show representative support-query episodes, with predicted and ground-truth tumor regions highlighted in purple.

Figure 3: Architecture of the Uncertainty-Aware Posterior Fusion (UAPF) module. The query-domain fused feature Fu is used to estimate pixel-wise variance, which guides posterior fusion between the meta-prediction Mmeta and the query-aligned prior Mprior.
